CustomField.description: Nullable: blank = standalone session outside any cycle, personal to its Tester (owner-or-admin on every read/write path). Cycled sessions are team-visible via the cycle audience; Apex enforces owner-or-admin on writes. Restricted delete: UatCycleAdminController.deleteCycle purges a cycle's sessions explicitly — SetNull would silently relabel deleted-cycle history as "Standalone".
CustomField.label: Test Cycle
